# Foxhound

> Foxhound is a failed-payment recovery, disputes, and subscription-intelligence platform for Stripe merchants. Outcome-based pricing: it earns only when it creates money the merchant can verify, above what Stripe's own tools would have recovered anyway.

Foxhound is built on Stripe Connect for subscription businesses. It sits on top of Stripe and acts after a payment fails, a dispute opens, or a subscription's billing signals change. Foxhound asks Stripe for two different OAuth scopes, and which one it asks for depends on what it is doing. The free audit requests READ-ONLY access: it computes a diagnostic and can change nothing. Connecting a merchant account at /connect requests read and write, because retrying a failed invoice is a write. The write half is used for three things: retrying payment on an invoice that has already failed, setting a customer default payment method after that customer updates their card, and submitting dispute evidence after someone on the merchant team approves it. Foxhound never changes prices, products, or subscription plans, never creates a charge outside an invoice the merchant already issued, and never reaches payouts or bank accounts.

## Products

- [Audit](https://foxhoundapp.com/products/audit): Free Stripe diagnostic. Identifies failed invoices, expiring cards, open disputes, and business health metrics. No account required.
- [Recovery](https://foxhoundapp.com/products/recovery): Silent retries first, then AI-drafted dunning email sequences across 30 days, calibrated by decline category. Recoveries Stripe's own tools would have gotten anyway are recorded and shown for free. Priced as a percentage of Foxhound-attributed recoveries only, and only once a recovery has matured 30 days. See https://foxhoundapp.com/pricing for the current rate.
- [Disputes](https://foxhoundapp.com/products/disputes): Evidence drafted automatically from Stripe data and recovery history. A human always reviews and signs before anything reaches Stripe; there is no auto-submit toggle. Priced as a percentage of won disputes only, capped per dispute, nothing on losses. See https://foxhoundapp.com/pricing for the current rate and cap.
- [Intelligence](https://foxhoundapp.com/products/intelligence): MRR, movement (new/expansion/contraction/churn), and cohort analytics are free for every Recovery merchant. The predictive risk-scoring layer is a flat monthly subscription. See https://foxhoundapp.com/pricing for the current rate.

## Pricing

- Audit: free, no account required
- Recovery: a percentage of Foxhound-attributed recoveries, billed only after a 30-day maturity window; baseline recoveries Stripe would have gotten anyway are never billed
- Disputes: a percentage of won disputes, capped per dispute, nothing on losses
- Intelligence: basic MRR/movement/cohort analytics free for Recovery merchants; predictive risk scoring is a flat monthly subscription
- No setup fees, no per-seat charges
- Current rates: https://foxhoundapp.com/pricing

## For agents

Foxhound exposes a Model Context Protocol endpoint at https://foxhoundapp.com/mcp, so an AI agent can read a merchant's own Foxhound data on their behalf. A merchant generates a key under Settings and API keys inside their account and gives it to the agent as a bearer token; the key decides which account the agent reads, one key to one account, always the one that issued it.

Most tools read: audit runs, the recovery queue, disputes, the billing ledger and invoices, the recurring-revenue overview, churn, customers, alerts, connected Stripe accounts, and the brand voice and merchant context an agent can also write. Eight tools write, and only to settings: the audit lookback and monthly report, the win-back and expiring-card features, notification email and Slack webhook and toggles, the sender name and the brand voice on a connected Stripe account, the merchant context the recovery-email writer is given, and alerts, which can be created, switched off and deleted. Each write runs the same validation the settings page runs and is recorded with the key that made it, the tool used and the field names touched, never the values. A field left out of a write is left as it is; only an empty value clears one.

There is no tool that submits dispute evidence, cancels an account, disconnects Stripe, issues another key or moves money: those do not exist rather than being switched off.

Customer names are never sent through the endpoint and email addresses are masked to their first character and domain. The Stripe customer id comes through whole, so an agent can correlate and ask a follow-up question without being able to contact anybody.

## Technical

- Built on Stripe Connect. The free audit requests a read-only OAuth scope; merchant onboarding requests read and write, and the writes are invoice retries, default payment method updates, and approved dispute evidence
- Hosted on Cloudflare Workers, database on Cloudflare D1
- No card data stored; all payment processing goes through Stripe
- Disconnect any time from the Stripe dashboard
